newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Stocks detract from Australia Q4 GDP.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Stocks detract from Australia Q4 GDP.

text.p: Growth in Australian private, non-farm inventories (stocks) detracted 0.1 percentage points from December quarter growth in GDP, a smaller detraction than economists typically expected.
But the September quarter stocks contribution was revised down by 0.7 percentage points to minus 0.2 percentage points from the 0.5 percentage points shown in the previous publication.
Revisions for March, June and September quarters total minus 0.4 percentage points.
The bureau said the value of private non-farm stocks in the quarter was A$61.731 billion in constant-price, seasonally adjusted terms, a rise of A$760 million from the previous quarter.
In the previous quarter, stocks rose a little faster, by A$830 million.
Since the rate of accumulation has declined by A$70 million, the data implies a detraction of about 0.1 percentage point.
Figures are rounded and may not add.
